mapper.select: SELECT ID_ FROM ACT_RU_TASK WHERE ID_=#{taskId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT t.ID_, t.DUE_DATE_, t.TENANT_ID_, o.trace_id,t.PROC_INST_ID_ AS process_instance_id,business.business_no FROM ACT_RU_TASK t LEFT JOIN workflow_execution_origin o ON o.tenant_id=t.TENANT_ID_ AND o.object_kind='TASK' AND o.object_id=t.ID_ LEFT JOIN approval_submission_round submitted ON submitted.tenant_id=t.TENANT_ID_ AND submitted.process_instance_id=t.PROC_INST_ID_ LEFT JOIN approval_application business ON business.tenant_id=submitted.tenant_id AND business.id=submitted.application_id WHERE t.SUSPENSION_STATE_=1 AND t.DUE_DATE_<=#{argument1} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ACT_RU_VARIABLE v WHERE v.TASK_ID_=t.ID_ AND v.NAME_=#{argument2}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ACT_RU_VARIABLE v WHERE v.TASK_ID_=t.ID_ AND v.NAME_=#{argument3}) AND (t.DUE_DATE_>#{argument4} OR (t.DUE_DATE_=#{argument5} AND t.ID_>#{argument6})) ORDER BY t.DUE_DATE_,t.ID_ LIMIT #{argument7}
